module_summary: Stream fork replicating one valid/ready input to NumOup outputs, using an input READY/WAIT FSM and per-output FSMs so the input handshakes only after every output has handshaked.

anchors.name: inp_state_q
anchors.why: Input FSM waiting until all outputs handshake before ready_o

anchors.name: gen_oup_state[*].oup_state_q
anchors.why: Per-output FSM remembering completed output handshake

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Input valid broadcast to all output valids

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Input ready asserted when all outputs have handshaked

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Per-output valid vector, dropped after that output handshaked

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Per-output ready vector completing output handshakes

anchors.name: oup_ready
anchors.why: Per-output done flags; all ones releases input in WAIT

groups.name: Input controller
groups.description: Joins output handshakes into a single input handshake

groups.name: Output controllers
groups.description: Replicated per-output FSMs generating valid_o bits

groups.name: Handshake ports
groups.description: Input valid and output readies feeding the FSMs
